description: Update a rule in the workspace library, or switch it off. Every project holding it is held to the new wording, so prefer editing the shared rule over adding a near-duplicate. Pass only the fields to change; at least one is required.

apply_to_design_reviews.description: Hold every design review in the workspace to this rule, project or not. Unchanged when omitted.

category.description: What kind of rule this is: design_system, tone_of_voice, brand, content (labels, terminology, formatting), accessibility, compliance, security, performance, or knowledge (anything else an actor should know).

content.description: The rule itself, written so someone can observe whether the product holds to it, e.g. "Primary buttons use sentence case." Trimmed and capped at 4000 characters.

enabled.description: False switches the rule off everywhere without removing it from the library; true switches it back on. Unchanged when omitted.

guideline_id.description: Library guideline UUID: the `id` from list_workspace_guidelines or list_project_guidelines (not the `attachment_id`).

title.description: New short name for the rule, capped at 160 characters. Unchanged when omitted.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: update_workspace_guideline

enabled.description: The library switch: false retires the rule everywhere.

id.description: Library guideline UUID, the guideline_id other tools take.

title: Update workspace guideline
